sheets.name: player
sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production character portrait sprite sheet for a small fantasy text game. Exact layout: 4 columns by 6 rows, 24 equal square cells, full bleed with NO gutters, borders, labels or text. Prefer canvas 1536 wide by 2304 high. Every cell is a centered face-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME identifiable person. Columns left to right are early adulthood, middle age, mature late adulthood, old age. Rows top to bottom: 1 JOY (clear warm smile), 2 SADNESS (lowered sorrowful eyes), 3 ANGER (brows knit and tense), 4 FATIGUE (heavy tired eyelids), 5 BEWILDERMENT (raised brows, visibly baffled), 6 NEUTRAL (calm resting expression). Strictly maintain this order and exact 24-cell grid. Each row must visibly differ in expression; each column must visibly age the same face with mature features, wrinkles and gray hair. Face stays at the same center and scale in every cell, entirely within its cell, ears and hair safely inside, no crossing cell boundaries. Attractive readable stylized painted illustration with clean low-noise shapes, restrained details suitable for 128px icons, natural anatomy, consistent dark neutral flat backdrop and soft light, NOT photorealistic skin pores. No speech bubbles, no logos, no weapons crossing cells, no extra faces, no text, no watermark. This is presentation art, no new story events, relationships or powers. Subject: the human protagonist shown in the reference, preserve his distinct identity and weak modest everyday-clothed appearance, black tousled hair, brown eyes, simple charcoal tunic. Ages visually around 20, 40, 60, 80 by columns. No demon horns, crown, magic, armor or muscular heroic redesign.
